Incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-6521 triggered — p99 latency breach on inference-service (eu-west-1). SLO=600ms, observed p99 ~1200ms. Spike started ~2026-03-15T12:06Z. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-6521
Jamal: Ack'd PD (PD-6521). I'm taking initial triage.
Sophie: on standby, pulling logs and metrics. @Jamal any 5xx or client errors?
Jamal: no 5xxs. Pure tail latency. Routes: /v1/generate (model: redwood-13b-quant).
Maria: :eyes: checking autoscaler & kvcache eviction graphs now. Miss rate looks high.
pagerduty-bot: PD-6521 acknowledged by Jamal at 2026-03-15T12:08Z. Next escalation: Sophie.
Sophie: repro attempt locally hitting same tail spikes. KV cache thrash + some hotkey behavior suspected.
Raj: copy. If KV thrash, routing to a variant with smaller batch windows helps. I have fallback routes ready.
Jamal: Starting quick canary: switch 50% of /v1/generate to redwood-13b-quant-slow (lower batch size, more predictable latency). Command: `rbacctl update route generate --model redwood-13b-quant-slow --canary 50`
Incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for route /v1/generate — canary 50%.
Maria: Sidecar logs (snippet):
```
[12:06:53] kvcache: miss rate 82%
[12:06:54] svc: request latency 1200ms pid=2334 route=/v1/generate
[12:06:55] gpu0: util 97% mem 88%
```
Emily: GPU pool saturated in eu-west. Proposing quick scale: `infractl scale gputier inference-prod-eu +2` (ETA ~90s).
Jamal: invoking scale now.
Emily: scale request submitted, watching node join events.
Sophie: also pushing config tweak to cap batching: `cfg set inference.batch.max_tokens=256 --route /v1/generate`
Raj: preparing fallback to redwood-7b-quant if scale+canary don't bring p99 down. Also drafting a short customer note for support team.
Jamal: applying temporary rate limit to reduce load: `ratelimit set /v1/generate 80rps` — will hold while we observe.
pagerduty-bot: PD-6521 escalation update sent to on-call rotation; next responder: Priya.
Jamal: Handoff plan — I'll monitor infra scale and canary for next ~10m, handing primary to Sophie at 12:20Z for the rotation.
Sophie: ack. I'll own verification and customer comms. Posting status to status page once we confirm improvement.
Maria: initial impact assessment: ~3% of global requests exceeded SLO during spike window; top affected tenants (finance-search, ad-retrieval) saw higher user-visible latency for ~2 minutes. No error-rate increase or data corruption.
Jamal: customer-impact summary: brief tail latency for small subset; prioritized tenants experienced slow responses but no request failures.
Sophie: Canary reports (50%): p99 reduced to ~700ms on canary traffic. Non-canary still ~1.1s.
Emily: new GPU nodes joining; cluster gpu util dropping to 75%.
Jamal: nice. Team, thanks. :thumbsup:
Incident-bot: Note added to PD-6521 by Jamal: "canary rollout, scaling initiated, rate-limiting applied".
Sophie: Runbook actions for handoff: watch p99 for 10m; if p99 > 900ms promote canary to 100% or trigger fallback to redwood-7b-quant. Also monitor kvcache hit rate and eviction metrics.
Raj: I'll update the runbook doc with the observed hotkey pattern and steps to pre-warm kvcache for heavy tenants.
Sophie: Updating status page: "Investigating — elevated inference latency in eu-west; mitigation in progress." Pinged support to notify affected tenants.
Support-bot: support-notify: customer advisory sent to affected tenant list (finance-search, ad-retrieval).
Sophie: Handoff to Priya at 12:30Z. @Priya please take over primary once on rotation.
Priya: Ack — taking over. Good work everyone. I'll post a short incident summary and close PD once p99 is stable below 600ms for 15m.
Jamal: Final notes: mitigation chain = rate-limit + canary -> scale -> batch cap -> fallback. No errors, no data loss.
Sophie: Leaving this thread open for postmortem link once created.
